items.title: Add opt-in Git ignore filtering to `uv_build`
items.reason: Direct implementation proposal opened in response to astral-sh/uv#22183. Adds disabled-by-default respect-ignore filtering for sdists and wheels. It excludes global Git rules and .git/info/exclude and does not add warning-only behavior. This responding PR does not make the issue a duplicate.

items.title: uv-build includes .mypy_cache in subdirectories by default
items.reason: Earlier report of unwanted module-tree files entering distributions. Maintainer comments explicitly confirm that avoiding gitignore and limiting default exclusions are intentional. That discussion concerns default filtering; this issue requests optional filtering or warnings.

items.title: Option to include vcs tracked files in source distribution with uv build backend
items.reason: Related optional VCS-based selection, but requests adding tracked files, including documentation and tests, to sdists. This issue instead requests excluding ignored files from sdists and wheels or warning about their inclusion.

items.title: fix(build): exclude dotfiles by default to match setuptools
items.reason: Unmerged proposal addressing astral-sh/uv#19403 by excluding all dotfiles by default. A maintainer rejected matching setuptools defaults. It neither implements optional Git-ignore filtering nor establishes a previous fix that has regressed.

items.title: Build backend tracking issue
items.reason: Reporter-cited design history surveys other backends' VCS-ignore behavior and links the include/exclude implementation. It tracks the overall backend and stabilization, rather than this specific optional capability.

related.search_scope: Used authenticated gh to search open/closed issues and open/closed/merged PRs in astral-sh/uv. Searched exclusion and warning requests separately using gitignore/build, VCS/ignore, respect-vcs-ignore, warn-vcs-ignored-files, respect-gitignore, uv_build/exclude, tracked files, sensitive files, packaging warnings, and area:build-backend. Read candidate discussions and followed references and timelines to astral-sh/uv#22240 and astral-sh/uv#19438. Inspected merged astral-sh/uv#9013, astral-sh/uv#9525, astral-sh/uv#9523, astral-sh/uv#9610, and astral-sh/uv#19991 for existing support. Ruled out astral-sh/uv#12970 (Hatchling/global excludes), astral-sh/uv#8833 (missing Hatchling artifacts), and astral-sh/uv#19990 with astral-sh/uv#19991 (uv-cache containment). REST rate limits and PR-filtered GraphQL searches returning issue nodes limited search coverage; linked PRs were inspected directly, and empty searches were not treated as proof of absence.

type_reason: The report requests new optional exclusion or warning behavior. Source and maintainer comments confirm that current VCS-independent selection is deliberate; no regression or failure of existing exclusion settings is established. Earlier default-filtering and tracked-file-inclusion discussions have different scopes. astral-sh/uv#22240 was created in response to this issue and therefore does not make it a duplicate.
summary: astral-sh/uv#22240 directly proposes the requested filtering and remains open. astral-sh/uv#19403 and astral-sh/uv#19438 explain the existing defaults; astral-sh/uv#16075 concerns distinct VCS inclusion behavior, and astral-sh/uv#8779 provides design history.
draft_response:
Your requested opt-in filtering is proposed in astral-sh/uv#22240, opened in response to this issue. It adds `tool.uv.build-backend.respect-ignore = true` for `.gitignore` filtering in sdists and wheels. The PR is still open; it does not include a warning-only mode or support global Git excludes.

The current defaults are intentional, as discussed in astral-sh/uv#19403. For now, add the files to `tool.uv.build-backend.source-exclude` to exclude them from both sdists and wheels; `wheel-exclude` alone leaves them eligible for the sdist. You can follow astral-sh/uv#22240 for the proposed option's review and scope.
